reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor, 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment/delegation/change-of-control transfer to Customer's consent (reasonableness-qualified) with a competitor bar, 24.3 sets a mutual reasonable-consent standard, and 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing, fee-acceleration or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control.

No redline or comment is expected for a compliant finding, and the rendered redline correctly leaves p0099-p0102 unchanged; the deterministic check confirming the successor/affiliate carve-out is consistent.

Minor residual note only (not a basis to fail): the competitor bar in 24.2 is framed as 'never ... without Customer's consent' rather than an absolute prohibition, which still leaves control with us and satisfies the substance of the preferred position.
